name: FFAS Cache Manager
author: Fernando Fas

sections.description: FFAS Cache Manager provides page caching with automatic invalidation when site content changes. Administrators can enable or disable caching, prewarm public pages, clear cached files, and manage browser-cache server rules.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP in Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate FFAS Cache Manager.
  3. Open FFAS Cache Manager in the WordPress dashboard and review the settings before enabling page caching.
sections.faq:
Does it delete content?

No. Clearing the cache removes only generated cache files.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial standalone release.
  • Added scoped settings export and import.
